newsitem.title: UK: Arjo Wiggins among day's top performers.
newsitem.headline: Arjo Wiggins among day's top performers.

text.p: Shares in British paper and packaging group Arjo Wiggins Appleton Plc were among the day's best performing stocks on Thursday after annual pre-tax profits of 133.9 million stg prompted analysts to upgrade earnings forecasts for the group. The shares were up 16-1/2p at 186-1/2p by 1550 GMT after four million shares had changed hands.
"The numbers were outside the top end of the range," said one industry analyst at a leading brokerage, who declined to be named.
The group has been hit by declining pulp prices in the last two years and reported 72 million stg profits in 1995.
Market sources said analysts at BZW raised the stock from a "sell" to a "hold" and upgraded earnings forecasts from 180 to 250 million stg for the current year.

"We will see a lot of upgrades from these figures," the analyst said. "Net interest was much better than expected and they had a very impressive performance on working capital. Cost cutting is progressing quite well and pricing in European copy paper looks a bit easier." --Elaine Hardcastle, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4027
